title: Jerome Moore
description: Jerome Moore on the Emperor's Royal Guard: "Silent, statuesque, and utterly mysterious, this crimson-robed sextet appears only briefly in Episode Six. Nevertheless, theirs is an intimidating presence as befits their station." Compelled by the Force to graduate from New York's High School of Art and Design, Moore began working for DC Comics, illustrating the company's top superhero characters. Not long ago he made his mark as cover artist for DC's STAR TREK titles. Currently he's rendering the comics adaptation of Arnold Schwarzenegger's LAST ACTION HERO, for Topps
